colors.reload: The colors of {{theme}} changed with the color themes mixed in. Reload the window to see them.

confirmReload: You have to restart VS Code to activate the changes to the icons.

fonts.missing: Cool Theme gives the editor the fonts of the JetBrains IDEs. Not installed: {{fonts}}. Until then, the editor uses the next font of the list.

opacity.wrongValue: The value must be between 0 and 1!

outdatedVersion: You have to update VS Code to use this command.

saturation.wrongValue: The value must be between 0 and 1!

themeMixer.byNameHint: The theme giving the icon of a file name, an extension (*.ext) or a folder (name/). It wins over the layers. Click an icon in the preview to set one.
themeMixer.colorByKeyHint: Single colors from a theme, over the layers: a workbench color id or a glob of them (terminal.*), scope:<TextMate scope> or semantic:<selector>. A later key wins over an earlier one.
themeMixer.colorInactive: Cool Islands is not the current color theme: the result is what it shows once selected (Preferences: Color Theme).
themeMixer.colorLayersHint: Other installed color themes mixed with Cool Islands, for the workbench colors and the syntax colors separately. Fill: only what Cool Islands has no color for. Override: that theme wins (for the syntax, its syntax colors replace the ones of Cool Islands). The first listed wins. A theme mixes into the Cool Islands theme of its own kind.
themeMixer.colorPreviewHint: Workbench colors and a line of code in the result, in Cool Islands alone and in each theme mixed in. VS Code shows the new colors after a reload of the window.
themeMixer.inactive: Cool Icons is not the current file icon theme: the result is what it shows once selected (Preferences: File Icon Theme).
themeMixer.layersHint: Other installed icon themes mixed with Cool Icons. Fill: only the names Cool Icons has no icon for. Override: every name the theme has an icon for. The first listed wins.
themeMixer.name: Name
themeMixer.noByName: No name has its own theme.
themeMixer.noColorByKey: No key has its own theme.
themeMixer.noColorLayers: No other theme is mixed: Cool Islands only.
themeMixer.noColorThemes: No other color theme is installed.
themeMixer.noLayers: No other theme is mixed: Cool Icons only.
themeMixer.noThemes: No other file icon theme is installed.
themeMixer.previewHint: Result: the icon shown in the explorer. The other columns: the icon of each installed theme. Click one to use it for that name, click it again to stop.
themeMixer.samplesHint: One per line; a folder ends with /.
themeMixer.title: Mix Themes
